label: Agent Listing Detail

scope.knownBoundary: Vite preload map still references api-*.js through click-time lazy services.

promotionCriteria: Phase 6 gate passes against the fresh build artifact.
stages.rollback: Do not deploy. Fix the failing source, audit, or budget layer locally.

promotionCriteria: Route loads without initial api-*.js static dependency.
Listing overview, seller onboarding preview, offers list, interested leads, and show-day sections render.
No new route-load JavaScript error appears in monitoring during the observation window.
stages.rollback: Revert or redeploy the previous application version. No database rollback is required.

stages.audience: one low-risk agency or internal production agency account
promotionCriteria: Canary users can open Agent Listing Detail for active and draft listings.
One seller-onboarding action, one offer action, and one show-day action are exercised successfully.
No material increase in Agent Listing Detail route-load errors or failed lazy-action imports.
stages.rollback: Redeploy the previous application version and keep Agent Listing Detail report-only.

promotionCriteria: Production canary completes without blocking incidents.
Phase 6 gate remains green on the release artifact.
Support and monitoring show no domain-specific regression trend.
stages.rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. Keep global enforceClean false until the preload-reference boundary is resolved.

stopConditions: Tracked heavy static imports are reintroduced.
The built Agent Listing Detail route statically depends on api-*.js.
Entry gzip exceeds 140 KB or static script gzip exceeds 750 KB.
Route-load errors or lazy-action import failures increase materially during staging or canary.
monitoringSignals: Agent Listing Detail route-load JavaScript errors
dynamic import failures for privateListingService, agencyPipelineService, buyerLifecycleService, listingOffersService, lead services, or seller services
offer invite or offer status action failures
route initial JS payload and static script dependency gzip
